content.subtitle: Why?
content.text:
The University of Cagliari has many things to be proud of, their eLearning website isn't one of those things.
There are many usability flaws in its current elearning website and in this concept I'm going to redesign the main issues: the dashboard and the homepage.

content.subtitle: The issues with the HomePage
content.text: The University of Cagliari’s eLearning homepage is a maze of poor design choices. Too many hamburger menus clutter the interface, making navigation confusing. The first thing you see isn’t your courses—it’s a manual, as if the website expects you to struggle. Faculty buttons all look the same, distinguished only by random images with no clear labels. There are countless buttons with unclear functions, leaving users guessing. Worst of all, the search bar—arguably the most important feature—is buried at the bottom of the page.
